hook: Pressing a shinbone with 2 newtons adds 79 days to lifespan.

sections.voiceover: Pressing a shinbone with 2 newtons adds 79 days to lifespan.
Oct 23 2026, Zhimin Zhang, Zhiqing Cai, Shencai Liu, Yun Chu, and Zhengtao Jiang reported shinbone loading activates osteocytes. How much longer did mice live after the 2‑newton press?
Yet the same compression also boosted maximum lifespan by 7.6%.

The mice’s median lifespan grew 9.4%, roughly 79.5 days longer. Maximum lifespan rose 7.6%, confirming a strong gain. It also improved movement and cognition after brain injury in mice and pigs, New Scientist.
A 79‑day lifespan boost comes from a simple press.
